items.description: Monthly trade volume and value for Orvan to Tolan maize imports.

queries.query: Tolan monthly maize import volume value Orvan source:trade_note 2025 2026

items.summary: No official trade notes or tables were found containing monthly volume or value data for maize imports from Orvan to Tolan for the 2025-2026 period. While similar data exists for Midgard (ORV-0030) and for Tolan's wheat imports (ORV-0046), the maize-specific data for Tolan remains absent from the available records as of 25 January 2027.

items.summary: New evidence provides monthly wheat export data from Vanir to Midgard (ORV-0027), which shows a rise in volume towards the end of 2026. Analyst notes suggest Vanir wheat volumes to Tolan and Midgard may increase by 14% to 18% (ORV-0018) or 'between a seventh and a fifth' (ORV-0007) from a small base. While rail loadings through the Ravik route are described as 'high' and 'rising' (ORV-0009, ORV-0035), specific aggregate quarterly volumes for rail and for Tolan's share of Vanir exports are still not available in quantitative form.
